payload.title: Rename 'content project' to 'content render'
payload.description: 'project' reads as a noun or a verb; the command renders the site. Rename to 'papyrus ops content render' (--all, --listings, --item-pages, --reconcile, --item), keep 'project' as a deprecated alias for one release, and update docs/site-hosting.md, the runbooks and each site's AGENTS.md.
